title: Sources: SpaceX decided to rent its Colossus 1 data center to Anthropic after internal teams struggled to use it for Grok development due to latency issues (Edward Ludlow/Bloomberg)
summary: Edward Ludlow / Bloomberg: Sources: SpaceX decided to rent its Colossus 1 data center to Anthropic after internal teams struggled to use it for Grok development due to latency issues — - Musk's firm struggled with latency issues with Colossus 1 — SpaceX has made AI infrastructure a key part of its IPO pitch
